svg.title: Disc spring pack stacking and force deflection curve
svg.text: Drawbar disc-spring pack: 36 × A 40 × 20.4 × 2.25 (DIN EN 16983 group 2) – 18 groups × 2 in parallel, groups in series
Pack formulas (n = 2 per group, i = 18 groups):
deflection s per disc (mm) / grey: pack travel 18 · s (mm)
unclamp piston: 1.1 × 12.97 = 14.3 kN → Ø63 annular (rod Ø30) at 6 MPa
release pressure 6 900 / 2 410 mm² = 2.9 MPa; full stroke 5.4 MPa
fatigue point II: σ 612 → 1 323 MPa, range 711 MPa per tool change → check DIN EN 16979
